name: Manufacturing
description: Materials manufacturer ERP: master data, inventory, sales, procurement, production, equipment, finance and R&D.
descriptionJa: 素材メーカーの基幹システム。マスタ・在庫・販売・購買・製造・設備・財務・研究開発を一通り含む。

tableDescriptions.MDM_CUSTOMERS: Customer master: the companies goods are sold to, with type, contact details and credit terms.
tableDescriptions.MDM_PRODUCTS: Product master: 200 raw materials and semi-finished goods with unit, unit price and description. Joined from inventory by PRODUCT_ID (no FK).
tableDescriptions.MDM_ORGANIZATIONS: Internal org chart: plants, divisions and departments, self-referencing through PARENT_ORG_ID.
tableDescriptions.MDM_SUPPLIERS: Supplier master used by purchasing and goods receipt.
tableDescriptions.MDM_MATERIALS: Material master describing the substances products are made of, separate from the sellable product catalogue.
tableDescriptions.INV_WAREHOUSES: The ten warehouses stock is held in, with location, capacity and status. WH-010 is deliberately in MAINTENANCE.
tableDescriptions.INV_INVENTORY: Stock on hand per product, warehouse and lot. QUANTITY minus RESERVED_QTY is what is actually available. Unique on (PRODUCT_ID, WAREHOUSE_ID, LOT_ID).
tableDescriptions.SAL_SALES_ORDERS: Sales order headers: customer, order date, requested delivery and status.
tableDescriptions.SAL_SALES_ORDER_ITEMS: Sales order lines: product, quantity, unit price and line total.
tableDescriptions.SAL_QUOTATIONS: Quotation headers issued to customers before an order is placed.
tableDescriptions.SAL_QUOTATION_ITEMS: Quotation lines with the quoted price and quantity.
tableDescriptions.SAL_CONTRACTS: Framework agreements with customers: validity period, committed volume and terms.
tableDescriptions.SAL_PRICE_AGREEMENTS: Negotiated prices per customer and product, valid over a date range.
tableDescriptions.EQP_EQUIPMENT: Production equipment master: type, plant location, install date and running status.
tableDescriptions.EQP_FAILURES: Equipment breakdowns: when, what failed, downtime and how it was resolved.
tableDescriptions.EQP_MAINTENANCE_PLANS: Planned maintenance: interval, next due date and responsible party per machine.
tableDescriptions.EQP_OPERATION_LOGS: Machine operating log: run hours, output and operator per shift.
tableDescriptions.FIN_RECEIVABLES: Accounts receivable: what customers owe, due date and settlement status.
tableDescriptions.FIN_PAYABLES: Accounts payable: what is owed to suppliers, with due date and status.
tableDescriptions.FIN_BUDGETS: Budgets by department and fiscal year.
tableDescriptions.FIN_BUDGET_PERIODS: Budget broken down into periods, with planned and actual amounts.
tableDescriptions.FIN_PRODUCT_COSTS: Standard cost per product: material, labour and overhead components.
tableDescriptions.MFG_RECIPES: Recipes (formulations) describing how a product is made.
tableDescriptions.MFG_RECIPE_PARAMETERS: Set points for a recipe: temperature, pressure, time and their tolerances.
tableDescriptions.MFG_PRODUCTION_PLANS: Production plans: what to make, how much and in which period.
tableDescriptions.MFG_PRODUCTION_ORDERS: Production orders released from a plan, with quantity, dates and status.
tableDescriptions.MFG_WORK_ORDERS: Shop-floor work orders derived from a production order, assigned to equipment.
tableDescriptions.MFG_PRODUCTION_RESULTS: Actual output reported against a production order: good quantity, scrap and time.
tableDescriptions.MFG_LOTS: Manufacturing lots, the unit of traceability linking output to inventory.
tableDescriptions.MFG_LOT_HISTORY: Lot genealogy: which lots were consumed to produce which lot.
tableDescriptions.MFG_PROCESS_RECORDS: Process data captured during a run: measured values against the recipe set points.
tableDescriptions.MFG_INSPECTIONS: General inspection records, including incoming and in-process checks.
tableDescriptions.MFG_QUALITY_INSPECTIONS: Quality inspections tied to a production order, with the measured result and verdict.
tableDescriptions.PRC_PURCHASE_REQUESTS: Purchase requisitions raised internally before an order is placed.
tableDescriptions.PRC_PURCHASE_REQUEST_ITEMS: Requisition lines: what is wanted, how much and when.
tableDescriptions.PRC_PURCHASE_ORDERS: Purchase order headers sent to suppliers.
tableDescriptions.PRC_PURCHASE_ORDER_ITEMS: Purchase order lines with quantity, price and delivery date.
tableDescriptions.PRC_GOODS_RECEIPTS: Goods receipt headers recording acceptance of a supplier delivery.
tableDescriptions.PRC_GOODS_RECEIPT_ITEMS: Goods receipt lines, including accepted and rejected quantities.
tableDescriptions.INV_RECEIPTS: Inbound delivery headers: what arrived at a warehouse, from which supplier, against which purchase order.
tableDescriptions.INV_RECEIPT_ITEMS: Line items of an inbound delivery: product, lot, quantity and put-away location.
tableDescriptions.INV_SHIPMENTS: Outbound delivery headers: what left a warehouse, for which customer and sales order, by which carrier.
tableDescriptions.INV_SHIPMENT_ITEMS: Line items of an outbound delivery.
tableDescriptions.INV_STOCK_MOVEMENTS: Every stock movement as an event: RECEIPT, SHIPMENT, TRANSFER and ADJUSTMENT, with the warehouse moved from and to.
tableDescriptions.RND_PROJECTS: R&D projects with owner, budget, timeline and status.
tableDescriptions.RND_MILESTONES: Project milestones and their planned versus actual dates.
tableDescriptions.RND_DOCUMENTS: Technical documents produced by a project.
tableDescriptions.RND_DOCUMENT_REVISIONS: Revision history of a document, with author and change summary.
tableDescriptions.RND_PATENTS: Patent filings arising from a project.
tableDescriptions.RND_PROTOTYPE_EVALUATIONS: Test results for a prototype, with pass/fail and notes.
